verdict.rationale: Polar's own refunds documentation says it makes it easy to issue both full and partial refunds, so the core refund capability is documented. The evidence never says which surfaces support it: neither dashboard-initiated nor API-initiated refunds are shown, and the general API, SDK and MCP evidence never mentions refunds. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of refunds from the dashboard, a documented refunds API endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
